name: AI Deep Dive — SEI — 2026-05-02
rationale: Solaris Energy Infrastructure is executing a successful pivot from oilfield equipment to modular data center power solutions. Revenue doubled to $622M TTM (+55.3%) and analysts project $825M Y1 (+32.7%) and $1.22B Y2 (+47.4%). EBITDA margin 29.7%, Rule of 40 score 85. DCF fair value $86.94 vs $72.33 (BUY +20.2%) driven by strong base case with 28% CAGR and 10% net margins. Data center power infrastructure is a multi-year secular tailwind.

bear.rationale: Data center capex stalls. SEI cannot complete the transition from oilfield to data center fast enough. Net margins stay near TTM 6.69% with heavy capex spending.

base.rationale: Analyst-aligned deceleration from 33%/47% trajectory. Net margins expand from 6.7% to 10% as data center segment scales and capex normalizes.

bull.rationale: Catalyst: AI hyperscaler buildout accelerates. SEI becomes preferred turnkey modular power solution for data centers. Margins expand to 18% as high-value data center contracts dominate.

aiThesis.rationale:
**BUY — Fair Value $86.94 vs $72.33 (+20.2%)**

Solaris Energy Infrastructure is successfully pivoting from oilfield equipment to modular data center power solutions. Revenue growth of 55.3% YoY, Rule of 40 score of 85, and analyst Strong Buy consensus at $83.57 (12 analysts) all point to a fundamentally sound growth story. The data center power buildout thesis (AI infrastructure requiring massive reliable power delivery) is a multi-year secular tailwind that SEI is well-positioned to capture.

The BUY at $86.94 (+20.2%) is supported by our base case DCF (28% 5-yr CAGR, 10% margin expansion, 25x exit PE) producing $57.08 present value, offset by a strong bull case ($281.76) on the AI acceleration scenario. The analyst target of $83.57 validates the thesis independently.

Key risks: FCF is deeply negative (-$438M TTM) as SEI deploys capital to build the modular power equipment fleet. If data center capex slows, SEI faces both revenue headwinds and stranded capital. The share count ambiguity is a data quality flag but does not change the directional thesis.

Base/bull scenarios project improvement to 10%/18% — justified by analyst Y1 EPS $1.52 implying ~10.7% forward margin.
